elsewhere.note: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness…
Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
